Proof

\sketch ↗ claim:l-geodesic-stays-in-ball ↗ claim:volume-comparison-time-slices By Claim 2, the relevant $\mathcal L$-geodesics remain in $B(x,T,r/2)$ until $\tau _1$. Since $|\Rm |\leq r^{-2}$ there, $R\geq -n(n-1)r^{-2}$, and hence $l_x(q,\tau _1)\geq -n(n-1)\varepsilon /3$. Therefore

\begin{equation} \widetilde V_x(W_{\mathrm{sm}}(\tau _1)) \leq \varepsilon ^{-n/2}r^{-n}e^{n(n-1)\varepsilon /3} \Vol _{g(T-\tau _1)}B(x,T,r). \end{equation}

Claim 2 and $\Vol _{g(T)}B(x,T,r)=\varepsilon ^nr^n$ bound the right-hand side by $1.1e^{1/12}\varepsilon ^{n/2}<2\varepsilon ^{n/2}$ after decreasing $\varepsilon _0$.

□
